i.norm: Tests how {@link Tag} resolves tag names and exposes the semantic options of a {@code <button>} element.

Resolving a tag name is case-insensitive: "script" and "SCRIPT" describe the same tag regardless of the platform's default locale.

Two lookup paths are checked:

  • the static {@link Tag#valueOf} factory, whose results are equal; and
  • a shared {@link TagSet}, which additionally returns the very same cached instance.
Static factory: lower- and upper-case names resolve to equal tags.
Shared TagSet: both names map to the identical cached instance.
A {@code <button>} is a known, inline (non-block) tag that acts as a readable-text boundary.
